$comment: Shot list for the hard fixtures (tools/eval/hard): English image-model prompts, keys <fixture id>/<NN>, the subject in brief.json is the source. Not generated yet: `pnpm fixtures:ai-photos generate --model gpt-image-2.5 --hard` makes them (paid). `style` is appended to every prompt, `poorStyle` instead to the photos listed in `poor` (dark phone photos, on purpose).
style: Realistic photograph taken with a good smartphone by the owner of a small business in Slovenia, for their own website. Natural available light, unstaged, true-to-life colours, ordinary everyday setting with small imperfections. No text, no lettering on signs or packaging, no logos, no watermark, no borders.
poorStyle: Photographed by the owner with an older smartphone in poor light, unedited: dark and underexposed, visible grain and noise, slightly soft focus with a little motion blur, a yellowish mixed artificial light, a slightly tilted frame with clutter at the edges. Realistic and ordinary, not artistic, not moody on purpose. No text, no lettering on signs or packaging, no logos, no watermark, no borders.

photos.apartmaji-pod-voglom/01: A traditional alpine house with wooden balconies full of red geraniums in a green valley, steep forested mountains behind it, a gravel parking area in front; summer morning.
photos.apartmaji-pod-voglom/02: The living room of a holiday apartment: a solid wooden table with four chairs, a small kitchen corner with light wood cabinets, a window with a mountain view, simple and clean.
photos.apartmaji-pod-voglom/03: An alpine lake early in the morning with thin mist over calm water, a wooden pier and mountains reflected in the surface, no people.
photos.apartmaji-pod-voglom/04: A wooden terrace with a table and chairs looking out over a meadow and a forest edge, a cup of coffee on the table, afternoon light.
photos.avtolicarstvo-gorenc/01: A car in a paint booth of a small body shop, parts masked with paper and tape, a front wing freshly primed in grey, bright booth lights.
photos.avtolicarstvo-gorenc/02: A small independent car workshop seen from the outside: a plain building with two open garage doors, a car on a lift visible inside, a few cars parked in front.
photos.avtosola-volan/01: A white small hatchback used by a driving school parked in an ordinary parking lot in front of a residential block, no stickers or lettering on the car.
photos.avtosola-volan/02: A motorcycle training ground on an empty asphalt lot with red and white traffic cones set out in a slalom, a learner motorcycle standing beside them, overcast day.
photos.cebelarstvo-medved/01: A wooden Slovenian beehouse with colourful painted beehive front panels standing on a meadow at the edge of a forest, bees in the air, sunny day.
photos.cistilni-servis-blesk/01: A just-cleaned kitchen in an ordinary apartment in the evening, shiny worktop and sink, a single ceiling light, dark window behind.
photos.cistilni-servis-blesk/02: A freshly washed staircase in an old apartment block, wet tiles, a weak bulb on the landing, a bucket and mop at the bottom of the stairs.
photos.cvetlicarna-zvoncek/01: The shop window and entrance of a small flower shop: metal buckets of cut tulips, roses and sunflowers on the pavement, potted plants inside behind the glass.
photos.cvetlicarna-zvoncek/02: A bridal bouquet of white roses and eucalyptus held in front of a white dress, only the hands and the bouquet in the frame, soft daylight.
photos.foto-rozman/01: A bride and groom walking hand in hand through a golden wheat field at sunset, photographed from a distance, warm backlight, flat lowland landscape.
photos.foto-rozman/02: A newborn baby sleeping curled up in a woven basket on a soft cream blanket, photographed from above, gentle window light.
photos.foto-rozman/03: A family with two small children walking along a path in a park in autumn, yellow leaves, the children running ahead, candid moment.
photos.foto-rozman/04: A business portrait of a man in his forties in a light blue shirt in front of a plain grey backdrop, relaxed smile, soft studio light.
photos.keramika-zupancic/01: A renovated bathroom with large grey porcelain tiles on the walls and floor, a walk-in shower with a glass panel, a simple white washbasin; finished, clean, no people.
photos.keramika-zupancic/02: A house terrace with floor tiles that look like wooden planks, a garden edge and a low wall, afternoon light.
photos.kovastvo-jereb/01: A blacksmith's forge in a small workshop, glowing coals and a piece of red-hot iron held with tongs, an anvil in the foreground, the rest of the workshop in darkness.
photos.kovastvo-jereb/02: A hand-forged black iron railing with scrolls along an indoor staircase in an old house, photographed from below.
photos.masaze-sanja/01: A massage table with a folded towel and a small bottle of oil in a small, warmly lit massage studio, a plant and a shelf with candles.
photos.okrepcevalnica-pri-jozi/01: A plate of a simple daily lunch: beef goulash with polenta and a small bowl of green salad on a wooden table in a modest snack bar.
photos.okrepcevalnica-pri-jozi/02: The interior of a small, plain snack bar with wooden tables and chairs, a bar counter with a coffee machine, daylight from the windows.
photos.siviljstvo-irena/01: A sewing machine on a work table with pieces of fabric, scissors, a tape measure and spools of thread, a seamstress's small workshop.
photos.siviljstvo-irena/02: A white custom-made wedding dress on a dressmaker's mannequin in a small sewing workshop, fabric rolls on a shelf behind.
photos.kozmeticni-studio-iris/01: A beauty treatment bed with a white towel and a magnifying lamp in a bright, simple cosmetic studio.
photos.kozmeticni-studio-iris/02: A client's hands during a manicure on a small table with bottles of nail polish, the beautician's gloved hands working, close up.
photos.studio-dih/01: A bright yoga room with wooden floors, large windows and yoga mats rolled up and stacked along the wall, a few blocks and blankets.
photos.studio-dih/02: A woman in a seated yoga pose on a mat beside a window, seen from the side, calm daylight, simple room.
photos.veterina-sapa/01: A small veterinary examination room with a stainless steel examination table, a cabinet with instruments and a weighing scale, clean and bright.
photos.veterina-sapa/02: The waiting room of a small veterinary clinic with a wooden bench, a water bowl for dogs on the floor and a plant, daylight.
